title: 20100130 Arrow Recipe
description: On 30 January 2010 the arrow recipe was updated from apples to iron.
body:
# 20100130 Arrow Recipe

This is just a simple recipe data pack, nothing special.

0.24_SURVIVAL_TEST; Arrows have been added as an object and are fired by pressing Tab. 20100128; Arrows can now be crafted using apples. 20100130; Arrows are once again now craftable. Iron is used instead of steel.

1 iron, 1 stick, and 1 feather will get you **4 arrows**. Extremely similar to todays recipe.

**Side Note**: The game will most likely tell you that the data pack is out of data depending on the version you are choosing to play but it works just fine 1.13-1.20
